ns2:section.sectionText: General Introduction to Philosophy, 3 hours. This is a general introduction to philosophy. We will think about some of the 'big' questions. What, if anything, can we know for certain? Is there a God? Are there things that are objectively right morally (or objectively wrong)? What kinds of things are we? Are 'minds' something distinct from bodies (or brains)? And so on. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
